description.en-US: Six books of Francis de Sales's spiritual letters to religious: the Filles-Dieu and other nuns before the Visitation, the early letters to the Visitation sisters, and letters on obedience, prayer, the festivals and the religious life, in Canon Mackey's English version.
description.pt-BR: Seis livros de cartas espirituais de São Francisco de Sales a religiosas: as anteriores à Visitação, as primeiras às irmãs da Visitação e as sobre obediência, oração, festas e vida religiosa, na versão inglesa do cônego Mackey.

en-US.editor: H. B. Mackey, O.S.B., introduction by Bishop Hedley (London: Burns & Oates, 1909)

sources.edition: Letters to Persons in Religion, tr. H. B. Mackey, Library of St. Francis de Sales IV (London: Burns & Oates, 1909), Internet Archive full-text OCR.
sources.description: Running heads and page numbers are dropped; the OCR was cleaned of line-break hyphens and the commonest recognition slips, and isolated slips remain. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: St. Francis de Sales died in 1622 and the edition is of 1909, so the text is public domain.
